Waddle has since progressed through the league's concussion protocol and is cleared to play against the Las Vegas Raiders this weekend. news.analysis: For the second straight game, Schultz finished with one reception for 11 yards. His one catch ended up in the end zone last week, however. That was not the case Thursday night, as the veteran TE did very little for fantasy managers who rolled him out there. Schultz has a combined total of four grabs over the last three games, so he is difficult to trust for fantasy purposes right now.

news.title: Dalton Schultz comes up with just one catch in Week 11 win

news.contents: Houston Texans tight end Dalton Schultz scored a touchdown last Sunday against the Cleveland Browns, but it came on his only catch of the game. Schultz now has just three receptions over the last two weeks, which is quite concerning for the No. 1 tight end in Houston. The 30-year-old has posted single-digit fantasy points in eight of his nine games this year. He's on pace for his worst season since 2019 with just 36 catches, 375 yards, and one touchdown so far, ranking as the TE20 in PPR ...
news.title: Dalton Schultz's Touchdown Masks Alarming Volume Numbers
